description: This file implements the Xls writer class for PhpSpreadsheet, providing functionality to serialize a Spreadsheet object into an Excel BIFF8-compatible XLS format. It manages constructing the OLE compound document, building necessary escher (drawing) objects, handling embedded images, and writing document properties.

classes.name: PhpSpreadsheet\Writer\Xls
classes.description: This class handles writing a PhpSpreadsheet object to the Excel BIFF8 (.xls) format, including managing embedded images, drawings, document properties, and the OLE compound file structure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Xls writer with a PhpSpreadsheet object and prepares the parser.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes the spreadsheet to a BIFF8 XLS file, constructing the OLE compound document, and writing all necessary streams and properties.

methods.name: buildWorksheetEschers
methods.description: Builds Escher drawing objects for worksheets, including images and shapes.

methods.name: buildWorkbookEscher
methods.description: Builds the Escher object representing all drawings in the workbook.

methods.name: writeDocumentSummaryInformation
methods.description: Creates the OLE stream content for document summary properties.

methods.name: writeSummaryInformation
methods.description: Creates the OLE stream content for document summary stream, including core properties like title, author, and keywords.
